explanation: Faithfully encodes the literal question on erdosproblems.com/231 (must every string of length 2^k - 1 over k letters contain an abelian square?) and its negative answer. As the docstring notes, it already fails at k = 2, 3 (121, 1213121), and for k ≥ 4 via de Bruijn–Erdős and Keränen. Formal proof linked.
